---
name: "Modernize UI — blue/gray card layout"
about: "Add blue/gray card-style CSS and an article list template. Only HTML/CSS changes."
---

This PR adds:

- `assets/css/styles.css` — global styles for a blue/gray card layout and sans-serif fonts.
- `templates/article-list.html` — an example article list template using the stylesheet.

No JavaScript files are modified.
